title: Preview the registered launch
when: Immediately before staffing an item or an itemless mandate
need: Preview, then create, naming only the item: routing picks the level from the item's workflow stage, then surface, model, effort and machine, and the item preview shows the route the create takes. Pass --level with --level-reason only when the work needs a level other than the item's effective stage level; placement flags only when a refusal names one, the operator asks, or a capacity recovery calls for it (level-launches Overrides). --level with --surface refuses level_selection_conflict. The engine composes item mandates. The opening hook binds through its launch-specific attestation, never folder/time proximity. An assigned worker must acknowledge and claim its own item before the deadline. Missing entry names launch_work_claim_missing and releases launch-only staffing. Read launch get for the exact session and recovery evidence.
surface: Steer worker-launch and model-selection -> launch help/preview -> level-launches Overrides.
recipes: yoke session-control launch preview --project P --item PREFIX-N
yoke session-control launch create --project P --item PREFIX-N --idempotency-key K
